name: Always Install Elevated Windows Installer
description: Detects Windows Installer service (msiexec.exe) trying to install MSI packages with SYSTEM privilege
author: GAI_CTI
query: (((process.executable:*\\Windows\\Installer\\* AND process.executable:*msi*) AND process.executable:*tmp) OR (process.executable:*\\msiexec.exe AND (winlog.event_data.IntegrityLevel:(System OR S\-1\-16\-16384)))) AND (user.name:(*AUTHORI* OR *AUTORI*)) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe OR (process.command_line:*\\system32\\msiexec.exe\ \/V OR process.parent.command_line:*\\system32\\msiexec.exe\ \/V) OR process.parent.executable:C\:\\ProgramData\\Sophos\\* OR process.parent.executable:C\:\\ProgramData\\Avira\\* OR (process.parent.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\Avast\ Software\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Avast\ Software\\*)) OR (process.parent.executable:(C\:\\Program\ Files\\Google\\Update\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Google\\Update\\*))))
